<Why>
At the end of a module the learner should see the whole picture again in one place, so the details of each step settle into one idea they can recall in an interview or an exam.
</Why>

<Idea>
A recap step repeats the main idea of the module in a few sentences and asks one last question.
</Idea>

<Question id="q-m90-s07" answer="c">
Which step kinds need a lab check?

- Concept and recap

  These steps teach or repeat; they have no lab check.

- Only concept

  Concept steps have no lab check.

- Lab and drill

  Right: both ask for something from the lab.

- Every kind

  Concept and recap steps have none.
</Question>
